Why Truck Owners Choose Rack N Road for SmartCap

SmartCap solves the biggest compromise truck owners face: sacrificing bed security and weather protection for an open-bed design. The world's first modular stainless steel truck cap transforms your truck bed into a secure, weatherproof, and fully customizable space — while supporting up to 770 lbs of static roof load for RTTs, racks, and cargo.

You can order a SmartCap online. The difference is what happens before, during, and after the sale. We don't dropship. We carry SmartCap inventory across 8 locations. We confirm vehicle-specific fitment before you spend a dollar. And our master technicians install it correctly the first time — no guesswork, no misalignment, no return trips.

We're not box sellers — we're configuration specialists. SmartCap alone is great. SmartCap combined with the right DECKED drawer system, rack setup, or cargo solution is transformational. We design the full system — fitment, load calculations, integration — so nothing conflicts and everything works together.

Our Installation Process

1

Configuration Consultation

We start by understanding how you use your truck. Work? Adventure? Both? We'll recommend the right SmartCap EVO model — or combination with DECKED — and confirm vehicle-specific fitment before you spend a dollar.

2

Precise Fitment Verification

Every SmartCap is designed for specific truck makes, models, years, and bed lengths. We verify your truck's configuration, check compatibility with existing accessories (racks, bed liners, DECKED systems), and confirm everything works together.

3

Professional Installation

SmartCap install is around 3 hours. Our master technicians handle precise alignment, proper sealing, and clean fit. If you're adding a DECKED system, rack, or other accessories, we integrate the full build in a single appointment. Best to leave it for the day.

4

Walkthrough & Support

We walk you through gullwing door operation, locking mechanisms, MOLLE panel integration, and roof rail usage. Questions, upgrades, or changes down the road — handled by the people who built it.

SmartCap Questions Answered

Common questions from customers considering SmartCap, answered by our team with 35 years of truck outfitting experience.

Fitment & Compatibility

Will SmartCap fit my truck? SmartCap makes caps for most popular truck platforms — Ford F-150, RAM 1500, Chevy Silverado/GMC Sierra, Toyota Tundra, Toyota Tacoma, and more. Every cap is designed for a specific make, model, year, and bed length. We'll confirm fitment before you buy.

Can I use SmartCap with a DECKED drawer system or bed liner? Yes. SmartCap pairs perfectly with DECKED drawer systems — it's one of our most popular combinations. It also works with spray-in bed liners. We'll verify your specific setup and confirm compatibility before installation.

Can I mount a rooftop tent or rack on SmartCap? Yes. SmartCap features integrated roof rails with a 770 lb static and 330 lb dynamic roof load rating. That's enough for rooftop tents, cargo baskets, bike racks, kayak carriers, and more. We'll help configure the right roof setup for your needs.

Construction & Durability

What is SmartCap made from? Stainless steel — not fiberglass. SmartCap is the world's first modular stainless steel truck cap. The 5-piece modular design means individual panels can be replaced or reconfigured without replacing the entire cap. It's built to outlast fiberglass alternatives by a wide margin.

Is SmartCap weatherproof? Yes. SmartCap features a positive pressure ventilation system that keeps dust and moisture out. The gullwing doors seal tight, and the stainless steel construction won't crack, fade, or degrade from UV exposure like fiberglass caps can.

Installation & Ownership

How long does installation take? If you're adding a DECKED drawer system, rack, or other accessories on the same visit, plan for a half-day appointment. Our technicians handle the full build in a single visit.

What makes SmartCap different from a fiberglass cap? Everything. SmartCap is forged from stainless steel, not fiberglass. It won't crack, fade, or degrade. The 5-piece modular design lets you swap or replace individual panels. Gullwing doors give you full side access. And the roof load rating (770 lb static) far exceeds what fiberglass caps can handle. It's a SEMA Award winner for good reason.

Do you have SmartCap in stock? We're a stocking authorized dealer — popular configurations for Ford and Toyota are typically in stock across our 8 locations. Less common applications may require ordering. Call for real-time availability before making the drive.

What's the warranty? SmartCap backs their products with a manufacturer warranty. Our installation is backed by our own guarantee — if there's ever an issue with how we installed it, we'll make it right. No runaround, no questions asked.
